articles.text: 教師: いらっしゃいませ。 (Kyoushi: Irasshaimase.)
INSTRUCTOR: Welcome!
学生: キャベツ一個ときゅうり一山ください。 (Gakusei: Kyabetsu ik-ko to kyuuri hito-yama kudasai.)
STUDENT: (one cabbage and a pile of cucumbers) Please give me one cabbage and a pile of cucumbers.
教師: キャベツ一個ときゅうり一山ですね。 (Kyoushi: Kyabetsu ik-ko to kyuuri hito-yama desu ne.)
INSTRUCTOR: One cabbage and a pile of cucumbers, right?
教師: いらっしゃいませ。 (Kyoushi: Irasshaimase.)
INSTRUCTOR: Welcome!
学生: りんご三個となし二個ください。 (Gakusei: Ringo san-ko to nashi ni-ko kudasai.)
STUDENT: (three apples and two pears) Please give me three apples and two pears.
教師: りんご三個となし二個ですね。 (Kyoushi: Ringo san-ko to nashi ni-ko desu ne.)
INSTRUCTOR: Three apples and two pears, right?
教師: いらっしゃいませ。 (Kyoushi: Irasshaimase.)
INSTRUCTOR: Welcome!
学生: トマト一山とキャベツ一個ください。 (Gakusei: Tomato hito-yama to kyabetsu ik-ko kudasai.)
STUDENT: (a pile of tomatoes and one cabbage) Please give me a pile of tomatoes and one cabbage.
教師: トマト一山とキャベツ一個ですね。 (Kyoushi: Tomato hito-yama to kyabetsu ik-ko desu ne.)
INSTRUCTOR: A pile of tomatoes and one cabbage, right?
教師: いらっしゃいませ。 (Kyoushi: Irasshaimase.)
INSTRUCTOR: Welcome!
学生: なし五個とにんじん一山ください。 (Gakusei: Nashi go-ko to ninjin hito-yama kudasai.)
STUDENT: (five pears and a pile of carrots) Please give me five pears and a pile of carrots.
教師: なし五個とにんじん一山ですね。 (Kyoushi: Nashi go-ko to ninjin hito-yama desu ne.)
INSTRUCTOR: Five pears and a pile of carrots, right?
教師: いらっしゃいませ。 (Kyoushi: Irasshaimase.)
INSTRUCTOR: Welcome!
学生: りんご二山とレタス一個ください。 (Gakusei: Ringo futa-yama to retasu ik-ko kudasai.)
STUDENT: (two piles of apples and a head of lettuce) Please give me two piles of apples and a head of lettuce.
教師: りんご二山とレタス一個ですね。 (Kyoushi: Ringo futa-yama to retasu ik-ko desu ne.)
INSTRUCTOR: Two piles of apples and a head of lettuce, right?
